svg.title: Project Qwen wiring schematic in PCB-schematic style: power, charging, Raspberry Pi with audio, PIR, flashlight and camera, ESP32 with level shifter, motor controllers, hall-sensor dividers, IR sensors, servos, potentiometer and indicator LEDs
svg.text: Dock: charger 29.7 V (no load) on two leaf-spring contacts.
Charging current enters through the battery's output leads
(the BMS turns the output off while the charge port is used).
1. All ground symbols are one common ground.
2. Global labels with the same name are connected.
3. U9's 10 kΩ pull-ups hold PWM high if the ESP32 is
unpowered, so the motors run. Planned: 10 kΩ pull-downs.
4. No fuses fitted yet (main, INA226 branch, Pi 5 V PTC).
5. Firmware drives off the dock at 90 % (BMS bypassed).
6. U7 is driven straight from GPIO23, above the pin's
7. U10/U11 hall connector Ha/Hb/Hc + 5 V/GND go to the motor.
